svg.title: VAE forward pass with the reparameterization trick
svg.desc: x goes into the encoder, which has two heads: mu and s = log sigma squared, K numbers each. sigma = exp(s/2). Noise epsilon from N(0, I) comes in from the side with no parameters. z = mu + sigma times epsilon feeds the decoder, which outputs x-hat. mu and s also feed the KL term. Solid arrows carry gradient; the dashed noise arrow does not.
svg.text: Backprop reaches μ and s through z (∂z/∂μ = 1, ∂z/∂σ = ε) and through the KL term.
solid: gradient flows back along this edge
dashed: random input, no gradient needed
